description:
Location: We are open to supporting remote work. Must reside in the United States.
 Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust
 
 As a Senior ServiceNow Developer , you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and supporting innovative solutions on the ServiceNow platform. You will partner with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams to deliver scalable applications, visualizations, and workflow solutions that drive business value. Your expertise in ServiceNow development, scripting, and platform best practices will contribute significantly to successful project outcomes and operational excellence.
 
 At the senior level, you are expected to work independently while providing technical leadership and guidance to other team members. Your responsibilities include:
 
 Application Design & Development 
 Continue to build out an existing custom scoped application and visualizations using the ServiceNow platform and related technologies.

 Maintain ServiceNow applications, custom components, workflows, and integrations.

 Leverage industry best practices to create scalable, maintainable, and high-performing solutions.

 Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership 
 Partner with Business Analysts and stakeholders to analyze requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.

 Recommend solution approaches, alternative designs, and implementation strategies that align with organizational objectives.

 Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development team members.

 Platform Development & Customization 
 Customize, and maintain ServiceNow applications using JavaScript, ServiceNow scripting, and other platform technologies.

 Configure platform capabilities, workflows, business rules, and user experiences to meet business requirements.

 Build responsive user interfaces and visualizations utilizing technologies such as AngularJS, React, HTML5, CSS, and related frameworks.

 Stakeholder Collaboration 
 Work closely with business and analytics teams to understand priorities and deliver effective technical solutions.

 Communicate technical concepts and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders on emerging technologies, platform capabilities, and best practices.

 Delivery & Quality Assurance 
 Ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, high-quality, and aligned with stakeholder expectations.

 Participate in solution testing, troubleshooting, and optimization efforts to ensure reliable performance.

 Maintain technical documentation and support knowledge-sharing across the team.

 Continuous Improvement 
 Stay current on ServiceNow platform enhancements, emerging technologies, and industry trends.

 Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase automation, and enhance user experiences.

 Contribute to the ongoing evolution of development standards and operational best practices.

 
 What You'll Need: 
 
 Basic Requirements 
 5+ years of application development experience on the ServiceNow platform.

 Must be a United States (U.S.) Citizen or Permanent Resident (Green card)

 Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust with the government

 Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S. and the work MUST BE PERFORMED in the United States (U.S.), as this work is for a federal contract, and laws do apply 

 
 What you’ll bring: 
 Strong knowledge of ServiceNow Platform capabilities, administration, customization, and scripting.

 Experience developing custom ServiceNow applications, and custom solutions.

 Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting.

 Experience with AngularJS, HTML5, CSS/CSS3, XML/JSON, REST services, and modern web development practices.

 Hands-on experience designing, debugging, and supporting enterprise applications.

 Ability to analyze complex business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Highly preferred: ITSM, ITOM, Scoped App experience

 ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, or other relevant credentials.

 Knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist and other platform AI features, with demonstrated experience supporting or implementing ServiceNow AI-driven solutions in enterprise environments

 Experience working in fast-paced, collaborative, and deadline-driven environments.

 Professional Skills 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple teams.

 Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality solutions.

 Strong customer focus and stakeholder management abilities.

 Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and technical excellence.

 Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

 
 Bot and Third-Party Applications 
 Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration.  Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration .   Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact  Candidateaccommodation@icf.com  for assistance.
 
 
 Working at ICF 
ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. 
 
 We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer .   Together, our employees are empowered to share their   expertise   and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our  EEO   policy. 
 
 We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 
   
 Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with   sincerely held   religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request   an accommodation,   please email  Candidateaccommodation@icf.com  and we will be happy to   assist . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent   required   to provide needed reasonable accommodations.    

 

 Read more about  workplace discrimination righ t s   or our benefit offerings which are included in the  Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage   Act.   

 
  
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or   assist   with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not   permitted . This policy is in place to   maintain   the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.    
 

 However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation  that involves the use of AI. If   such an   accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at  candidateaccommodation@icf.com . We   are dedicated to providing   the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.   


 
 
 Pay Range - There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. 
 
 The pay range for this position based on full-time employment is :
$81,499.00 - $167,644.00
